# Zscaler Firewall Overview — ASIM parity

Normalized Zscaler Internet Access telemetry delivered exclusively through Cribl. Lineage: `Azure/Azure-Sentinel` commit `cd455a8cecf3e5e983f9cd08191dca3d211c9fa1`, `Solutions/Zscaler Internet Access/Workbooks/NSSFWLogs.json`. Vendor-specific values are read from documented `AdditionalFields` keys; select a time range and workspace below.

parameters.name: SourceIP
parameters.label: Source IP
parameters.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSFWlog'

| where isnotempty(SrcIpAddr)
| summarize Count=count() by Value=tostring(SrcIpAddr)
| order by Count desc
| project Value,Label=strcat(Value,' count: ',Count)
| take 250

parameters.name: SourcePort
parameters.label: Source Port
parameters.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSFWlog'
| where ('{SourceIP:label}' == 'All' or SrcIpAddr in ({SourceIP}))
| where isnotempty(SrcPortNumber)
| summarize Count=count() by Value=tostring(SrcPortNumber)
| order by Count desc
| project Value,Label=strcat(Value,' count: ',Count)
| take 250

content.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSFWlog'
| where ('{SourceIP:label}' == 'All' or SrcIpAddr in ({SourceIP}))
| where ('{SourcePort:label}' == 'All' or tostring(SrcPortNumber) in ({SourcePort}))
| where ('{DestinationIP:label}' == 'All' or DstIpAddr in ({DestinationIP}))
| where ('{DestinationPort:label}' == 'All' or tostring(DstPortNumber) in ({DestinationPort}))
| where EventResult =~ 'Failure' or DvcAction in~ ('Deny','Drop','Block')
| summarize Count=count() by Protocol=NetworkApplicationProtocol
| top 10 by Count desc
content.title: Top blocked protocols

content.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSFWlog'
| where ('{SourceIP:label}' == 'All' or SrcIpAddr in ({SourceIP}))
| where ('{SourcePort:label}' == 'All' or tostring(SrcPortNumber) in ({SourcePort}))
| where ('{DestinationIP:label}' == 'All' or DstIpAddr in ({DestinationIP}))
| where ('{DestinationPort:label}' == 'All' or tostring(DstPortNumber) in ({DestinationPort}))
| where EventResult =~ 'Success' or DvcAction =~ 'Allow'
| extend Location=tostring(AdditionalFields['Location'])
| summarize ['Recived MB']=sum(todouble(DstBytes))/1024.0/1024.0, ['Sent MB']=sum(todouble(SrcBytes))/1024.0/1024.0 by bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain}), Location
| order by ['Recived MB'] desc,['Sent MB'] desc
content.title: Non-http downloads and uploads in MB

_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSFWlog'
| where ('{SourceIP:label}' == 'All' or SrcIpAddr in ({SourceIP}))
| where ('{SourcePort:label}' == 'All' or tostring(SrcPortNumber) in ({SourcePort}))
| where ('{DestinationIP:label}' == 'All' or DstIpAddr in ({DestinationIP}))
| where ('{DestinationPort:label}' == 'All' or tostring(DstPortNumber) in ({DestinationPort}))
| where EventResult =~ 'Success' or DvcAction =~ 'Allow'
| extend Location=tostring(AdditionalFields['Location'])
| where '{LocationFilter}' == 'All' or Location == '{LocationFilter}'
| summarize ['Recived MB']=sum(todouble(DstBytes))/1024.0/1024.0, ['Sent MB']=sum(todouble(SrcBytes))/1024.0/1024.0 by bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain}), Location
content.title: Non-http downloads and uploads in MB — selected location

_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
